# TikTok Web Browser Fingerprint API

Provides browser fingerprint values for TikTok web automation. Accepts an optional `browser_type` to define the target environment.

## Use cases

- Configure browser profile parameters for TikTok web calls.
- Simulate distinct browser environments in test workflows.
- Standardize client fingerprinting across automated sessions.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/tiktok/web/generate-fingerprint" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `browser_type` | string | No | — |

## Example response

Real response for the request above, trimmed to the main fields. User names and long IDs are masked.

```json
{
  "browser_type": "random"
}
```

## Notes

- The `browser_type` parameter is optional.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [TikTok Video IDs from URLs (Batch)](/model/tiktok/web/all-aweme-id): Resolves and extracts TikTok video IDs from a list of video URLs.
- [TikTok User Sec User ID Extractor](/model/tiktok/web/all-sec-user-id): Returns a list of sec_user_id identifiers corresponding to TikTok user profile URLs.
- [TikTok Profile Unique IDs](/model/tiktok/web/all-unique-id): Resolves a batch of TikTok user homepage links to retrieve their corresponding unique identifiers.
